new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Bluewaters Island?
Private dining in Bluewaters Island starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Bluewaters Island do you serve?

All of Bluewaters Island — Bluewaters Residences apartments and penthouses, beachfront townhouses and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
From menu planning to the chef, the service staff, the plating and the cleanup — one team covers all of it.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can you cater a dinner party or larger event on Bluewaters Island?
Yes. From an intimate in-villa chef dinner for two to Bluewaters Island party catering for fifty on a penthouse terrace, the same team scales the kitchen, service staff and menu to the room.
Do you offer halal and allergen-aware dietary menus?

Yes. Every menu can be built fully halal, and vegetarian and vegan requests are handled as standard. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
How far ahead should I book a private chef on Bluewaters Island?
Three to five days is comfortable for most dinners; weekends, large events and peak dates fill sooner. Same-week and next-day bookings are often possible — ask and we will check chef availability.
Is it a personal chef in my own kitchen or drop-off catering?
It is a personal chef who cooks in your own kitchen and plates each course to order. If you prefer, we also arrange drop-off and canapé-style Bluewaters Island catering services for lighter formats.
Can I request a female private chef on Bluewaters Island?

Yes — a female chef can be requested for your booking. Tell us when you enquire and myCHEF brings you a female chef from the partner network for your date, cuisine and service style. On Bluewaters Island it is a regular request from family apartments and from hosts planning women-only gatherings, and raising it alongside your date gives the widest choice, because availability moves with the date, the cuisine and who in the partner network is free.
For private chef bluewaters island, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
